comparisons.peer_topic: Core Business Focus and Platform Evolution
comparisons.peer_summary: NVIDIA pioneered accelerated computing and has expanded from its original PC graphics focus to serve computationally intensive fields, leveraging GPU architecture for AI, data science, AV, and other platforms.
comparisons.comparison: Both Intel and NVIDIA describe their product portfolios in the context of computational hardware evolution for AI and intensive workloads. Intel highlights an extensive portfolio of silicon products including CPUs and accelerators, supported by software for workload mobility. Similarly, NVIDIA describes its leveraged GPU architecture to create platforms for AI and accelerated computing, expanding beyond graphics. Both disclosures focus on the integration of hardware and software to support specific computational demands, though Intel emphasizes heterogeneity and workload mobility across architectures while NVIDIA emphasizes the singular leveraging of GPU architecture for accelerated computing platforms.

sentences.text: We provide our customers with an extensive portfolio of silicon and software products, engineered to deliver workload-optimized performance.
Our hardware portfolio primarily comprises CPUs and also includes accelerators, all designed to support the performance, agility, and security that our customers demand.
Since our original focus on PC graphics, we have expanded to several other large and important computationally intensive fields.
NVIDIA has leveraged its GPU architecture to create platforms for accelerated computing, AI solutions, scientific computing, data science, AV, robotics, metaverse and 3D internet applications.
